config_entries.label: Alpha
config_entries.description: The forget factor/alpha value of the filter. A higher value includes more details in the output while a lower value removes more noise. Defaults to `0.1`.

config_entries.label: Send Every
config_entries.description: How often a sensor value should be pushed out. Defaults to `15`.

config_entries.label: Send First At
config_entries.description: By default, the very first raw value on boot is immediately published. With this parameter you can specify when the very first value is to be sent. Defaults to `1`.
